request.intent: Close the Python runtime resilience task with corrected test instructions, complete implementation provenance, verified case evidence, and the current resumable handoff.

resolution.summary: All project Python commands use a CMD entrypoint backed by a validating PowerShell implementation, or an exact workspace-provided interpreter path; the launcher works with an empty PATH and rejects an invalid explicit runtime without fallback.

review_triggers: tools/runtime/run_python.cmd fails to locate a runtime in a supported workspace
a maintained procedure or active command reintroduces reliance on a bare python executable
tests/context/test_python_runtime_launcher.py fails or the bundled runtime layout changes

symptom.summary: A project command invoked the bare name python, and Windows PowerShell returned CommandNotFoundException even though the bundled workspace Python runtime existed.

record.title: Python runtime command unavailable on PATH
